messages:
chris: Follow-up for Artemis Dedicated postmortem. Root causes: flapping VPC peering + on-prem NAT ephemeral exhaustion -> edge service entered tenant isolation. Need clear owners, short mitigations, and a permanent fix timeline. Packet captures attached in the postmortem doc: https://intra.redwood/pm/artemis-isol

nina: I'll pick the short-term mitigation: add a per-tenant cooldown and rate-limit reconnects at the edge proxy. Plan: feature flag + telemetry. ETA initial patch Wed 04/01.

sam: I'll own the root-cause fix for the peering instability: instrument BGP session jitter metrics and add a circuit-breaker that anneals over 30m. Prototype by Mon 03/30, PR to follow. Ticket: TCK-2334.

mira: Ops will draft an on-prem preflight checklist for customers (NAT table size, ephemeral port ranges, TCP TIME_WAIT tuning). Will include tcpdump capture guidance. Target EOD Tue 03/31.

ops-bot: Created ticket TCK-2334: "Artemis: BGP jitter metrics + peering CB" assigned to eng-networking. Link: https://tracker.redwood/TCK-2334

chris: Quick mitigation suggestion: enable selective tenant backoff on edge and hold recon attempts for 60s after N failures. Who can add a config toggle so Dedicated tenants can opt in?

nina: That's the plan. I'll add a config field and feature-gate default off for Dedicated. Will update docs and console expose.

sam: For the circuit-breaker, proposing exponential backoff with max cap and token-bucket to smooth bursts. Also emit a per-tenant metric: peer_reauths/min. We'll wire alerts on that.

mira: Ops alert proposal: peer_reauths/min > 120 for 5m OR BGP flaps > 4 in 10m -> page oncall and open a remediation runbook. Creating ALERT-9021.

ops-bot: ALERT-9021 created: "Artemis: peer_reauths/min and BGP flap escalation" -> https://tracker.redwood/ALERT-9021

chris: I'll coordinate a joint test window with the Artemis infra team. Prefer Wed 04/01 09:00 PT. Nina/sam, please post PR links before then so we can exercise them in the test.

nina: Will post PR and feature-flag instructions by Tue 03/31.

sam: PR draft up by Mon 03/30. Integration test harness needs a simulated BGP flap generator; I'll add a lightweight tool under infra/tests/sim-peer.

mira: The runbook will include exact troubleshooting commands for customers and support:
```
# ephemeral ports usage
ss -s | grep "ephemeral"
# established connection count by remote
netstat -anp | grep ESTABLISHED | awk '{print $5}' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
# quick pcap
tcpdump -w /tmp/artemis-cap.pcap host <peer-ip> and port <peer-port>
```
Will attach expected thresholds.

chris: Consolidated action items (short):
- A1: Edge tenant cooldown & rate-limit (short-term) - owner: nina - due: 2026-04-01
- A2: BGP jitter metrics + circuit-breaker - owner: sam - due: 2026-03-30 - ticket: TCK-2334
- A3: On-prem preflight + tcpdump checklist - owner: mira - due: 2026-03-31
- A4: Ops alerts for peer_reauths/BGP flaps - owner: eng-infra (ops) - alert: ALERT-9021
- A5: Joint test window with customer - owner: chris/liz-ops - proposed date: 2026-04-01

nina: Note: A1 will default disabled for Dedicated; we'll provide rollback instructions and metric keys.

sam: Will add unit/integration tests and a small chaos test that induces repeated BGP session resets.

mira: I'll add a Grafana panel template and embed it in the runbook. ETA Fri 03/27.

chris: Let's reconvene Thu 03/26 11:00 PT for status. Please drop PR links, ticket IDs, or test results here. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
